items.title: Meta stock jumps as Wells Fargo raises price target
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to discuss Meta (META) more than 10% intraday surge after Wells Fargo (WFC) raised its price target on the stock from $640 to $796. Meta also got a boost from its Meta Muse AI agent app climbing to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store, highlighting growing momentum around the company's AI push.
